new-zealand.title: Flag of New Zealand

colors.note: Represents the Southern Ocean and Commonwealth

desc: - A royal blue field with the Union Jack in the canton and four red stars with white borders representing the Southern Cross. Formally adopted in 1902
trivia:
- The Union Jack reflects New Zealand's historical ties to Britain
- The four red stars represent the Southern Cross constellation
- New Zealand adopted this flag in 1902; it remains one of the last Commonwealth nations using the Union Jack
